notes.title: Melody’s Melon Mania Playtest Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090971/1d2cdd7983b8d5562253ae2037a3802695b241bb.png[/img]

Heyhey Scientists!

We have been working on this small Birthday Present for Projekt Melody over the last month and originally wanted to release it for her birthday. But with the celebration pushed back into August, we decided giving the game more time to breathe could help and ended up doing a nice polish pass on all its core systems over the last week.

We invite any of you to playtest the game and give us feedback on what could be improved before we make it officially available for everyone on Steam! [b]Join the playtest by clicking the 'Request Access' button on the game's page![/b]

Please tell us what you think in the comments below, and we'll start patching away!

Let's get this game ready for Mel's Birthday Stream together! ❤️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078530/Melodys_Melon_Mania/
